memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus went home with them, and He obeyed them.

sequence.prompt: What happened when Jesus was twelve? Put it in order.

items.label: The family went to the festival
Jesus was not in the group
They found Him with the teachers

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: He had jobs and a bedtime, like you
Jesus knew who He really was
Saul did most; Jesus did all of it

application.question: Jesus obeyed every single day. Which ordinary job do you find hardest?
application.followUp: This is not 'be as good as Jesus' — nobody can be. Jesus obeyed perfectly in your place, because you cannot. He knows exactly what your day feels like, because He had one too. Jesus always obeyed God.
